text_block_list.text:
This morning, I awoke with the<n>sunrise, so I decide
to head to the<n>academy early.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. It really is a<n>lovely day,
don't you think? ♪
choice_data_list: Morning! You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, I had a wonderful koto lesson<n>on my day off
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's such a rewarding<n>feeling—producing beautiful
tones with<n>your own two hands.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm ready to hop right back on<n>the path to the
top at full strength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Grass Wonder was<n>able to rest well
during her day off.
